_comment: SHARED SDXL masked-inpaint workflow (ComfyUI API format) — the single template behind every object-level AI feature (Replace, Remove, Recolor, Change Clothes, Change Hair, Replace Person). The graph STRUCTURE lives here; backend/comfy_engine.py injects per-request VALUES by node id (checkpoint, init image name, mask image name, prompts, sampler). Flow: load checkpoint -> encode prompts -> VAE-encode the init crop -> restrict denoising to the mask (SetLatentNoiseMask) -> KSampler harmonises ONLY the masked region into the scene -> decode -> save. Everything outside the mask is reconstructed from the original latent, so surrounding pixels are preserved. The legacy per-feature workflow JSONs remain on disk for reference and are still drivable by the same injector (the mask node is found by class_type). Phase-3 ControlNet conditioning can be added by comfy_engine without editing feature modules.

inputs.text: blurry, lowres, distorted, deformed, artifacts, seam, extra objects, watermark, text
